meta: Web application development on ASP.NET Core and Angular: portals, dashboards and business systems, secure by design and tested before launch.
h1: Web applications built for how your business works
lead: Customer portals, internal systems and dashboards, built on proven enterprise technology and secured from the first design.

items.p: Self-service portals where customers and partners log in, manage accounts and track requests.
Admin panels and workflow tools that replace spreadsheets and email threads.
Live reporting on operations, sales and performance, with role-based views.
Fast, app-like web experiences that work across desktop and mobile.
Old systems rebuilt in stages, running side by side with the new one where needed.
Connections to the payment, CRM and ERP systems you already use.

items: Content security policy and XSS hardening

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: Can you rebuild our old system without stopping the business?
Yes. We modernize in stages, running old and new side by side where needed, so your team keeps working throughout.
How long does a web application take?
It depends on scope. After a short discovery phase we give you a timeline and either a fixed-scope quote or a monthly rate.

items.p: Secure APIs that connect payments, CRMs, ERPs and partners.
Secure pipelines, containers and cloud infrastructure.
Manual testing with a report your developers and auditors can use.
